Class Delay<T>

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.env.Delay<T>
Type Parameters:
T - what is handed on; never changed after it has been put in
public final class Delay<T> extends Object
Hands things on a fixed number of ticks late: what one fighter gets to know of the other on a server, where everything has gone through the network first.
